Operate directly on image channels:

magick image.jpg image.png
A image setting
Copies the alpha channel values into all the color channels
If it was previously turned off then it also resets the channel to opaque.
Does not delete or change the existing data, just turns off the use of that data.

An image setting stays in effect until it is reset or the command-line terminates.
-alpha
Copies the alpha channel values into all the color channels
Note normally Set should be used instead of this, unless you specifically need to preserve existing (but specifically turned Off) transparency channel.
If it was previously turned off then it also resets the channel to opaque.

Input Filename
an explicit image format
ImageMagick must know the format of the image before it can be read and processed
Most formats have a signature within the image that uniquely identifies the format.
Failing that, ImageMagick leverages the filename extension to determine the format.
In these cases an explicit image format must be specified.
